svg.title: Archon concepts: where things live, how one run flows, who decides what
svg.text: Three questions a beginner asks: where does everything live, how does one run flow, and who decides what. Analogy throughout: a restaurant kitchen with a recipe card for every dish.
two places: the team's workspace with its repos, and your machine's ~/.archon
the team's workspace · its own git repo · committed
the kitchen: the cookbook lives here; a folder project
what Archon reads from the workspace root
long prompts, kept out of YAML
OURS: the rules (read in every AI node), the check, the request
the code repo · cloned inside · its own git, PRs
the pantry: .gitignore keeps it out; the agent branches here
your machine · never committed · the cook's locker
every run: status, answers, tokens, cost
the Web UI, fetched by archon serve
a folder project: no worktrees/, the run works in place
cd java-workspace; archon workflow run request-to-pr --folder "…"
requirements · loop_group · max 3 · until the decision is approve
exit 0 ends it; 3 failed passes fail it
the code, not the model, says done
pushes the branch the agent made in priorauth-api;
the pull request, the merge, the tidy-up are yours (OURS)
AI node: Claude Code runs it
wait: the run pauses for you
each run: in place in the workspace, artifacts and transcript, and a run id to find it by
you decide; Archon runs and records; the agent works; code checks
You · the chef at the pass
write the workflow (a PR on the YAML), start the run
answer at every wait; archon workflow attention lists them:
in the run: 7 questions answered, requirements rejected
once, plan approved, change rejected (a 500, by hand)
Archon · the expediter calling the orders
walks the graph: depends_on, when, trigger_rule
starts each node in the workspace, pauses at waits
routes reject only where the YAML says (when: … 'reject')
records transcript, artifacts, tokens and cost per run
Claude Code (or Codex, Pi) inside AI nodes only
reads CLAUDE.md; a fresh session per node or loop pass
tiers: small = haiku · medium = sonnet · large = opus
The code · the timer and the thermometer
bash nodes check and push without a model
mutates_checkout: false fails a node that edits files
Reject is an answer, not a stop.
Inside a loop_group it means "revise"; before a cancel node
it ends the run. In place means your own clones:
what the agent committed stays on its branch.
Every answer is kept with the run:
who said what, and when, is in archon.db and the transcript.
Archon 0.13.2 (29 Oct 2026) and its docs at archon.diy · node ids and settings read from the course's request-to-pr.yaml · analogies ours
